data.title: 五更琉璃 · 散落床单的命定黑蕾丝
data.description: 静谧的寝室内摆着可爱的黑猫玩偶与轻小说原稿。琉璃身穿一袭精致半透的黑色蕾丝娃娃装吊带短裙，斜倚在深色床铺上。姬发式的乌黑长发如黑丝缎铺展在枕榻间，胸前红水晶项链泛着微光。她微微别过通红的脸蛋，用蚊子般细小的声音说着傲娇而认真的命运誓言，眼神中却盛满了对你毫无保留的迷恋。
data.location: dim cozy bedroom with sheer black lace curtains
data.action: reclining on dark bed in sheer black lace babydoll negligee, black hime-cut hair spread on sheets, red pendant necklace on collarbone, flushed cheeks, looking away shyly then back to viewer
data.lighting: dim romantic fairy lights combined with soft moonlight through curtains
data.mood: charming gothic tsundere romance, delicate midnight seduction
data.promptProse: Reclining on her bed in a sheer black lace babydoll negligee, Kuroneko holds her red gem pendant against delicate collarbones. Her black hime cut flows over pillows as she turns with a shy, tsundere blush.
data.animaCaption: Kuroneko resting on her bed in a black lace negligee with her red pendant glowing softly.
